# Quiet Money

> The money rules nobody taught you. Short videos on money psychology and personal finance, each written out with its math and sources.

Educational content, not financial advice. Every number is computed; every story is sourced.

## Pages
- [Money Rules Library](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/): every video as a written page
- [Calculators](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/tools/): compound growth, credit card payoff, inflation
- [Free 7-day Money Reset](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/): printable checklist
- [The Quiet Money Daily Planner](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/planner/): a 365-day printable money planner (paid): what is inside and honest notes
- [About](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/about/): what Quiet Money is and how videos are made

## Money rules
- [Write Your Asset Column in 10 Minutes](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/write-your-asset-column-in-10-minutes/): Learn how to build a real asset column in ten minutes. Distinguish between assets and liabilities and set up automated momentum today.
- [Why You Rewrite Your Money Memories](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-you-rewrite-your-money-memories/): Hindsight bias tricks you into believing your financial intuition is flawless by rewriting your past memories of market moves.
- [The $5 Daily Habit That Costs You $226,000](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-5-daily-habit-that-costs-you-226-000/): We break down the exact compounding math of a $5 daily habit invested in an index fund at 8% annually versus spending it on daily takeout drinks.
- [The $35 Billion Illusion: How Eike Batista Lost It All](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-35-billion-illusion-how-eike-batista-lost-it-all/): Eike Batista became the world's 7th richest man with a $35 billion paper net worth built on speculative oil projections and heavy debt. When real oil production failed to materialize, his paper empire collapsed into over $1 billion of debt in under 18 months.
- [The 0% Balance Transfer Fee Math](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-0-balance-transfer-fee-math/): Calculating the exact break-even point and hidden fees when moving high-interest debt to a 0% introductory rate card.
- [How a Billionaire Lost His NFL Team at Blackjack](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/how-a-billionaire-lost-his-nfl-team-at-blackjack/): The true story of Leonard Tose losing the Philadelphia Eagles at the blackjack table, and the money psychology lesson on sunk costs and discipline.
- [The Checking Account Cash Trap](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-checking-account-cash-trap/): Keeping six months of living expenses in a standard checking account creates massive inflation drag. Learn the Tiered Liquidity Rule to keep your cash safe and productive.
- [Why Buying Cash Flow Beats Starting from Zero](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-buying-cash-flow-beats-starting-from-zero/): Starting a business from scratch comes with high failure rates and unpaid years. Acquiring established cash flow using debt leverage offers an alternative path, though managing loan obligations during down years is critical.
- [The Cost-Per-Use Rule That Saves Thousands](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-cost-per-use-rule-that-saves-thousands/): Why buying the cheapest option often drains your wealth through high replacement frequency. Use the Cost-Per-Use rule to evaluate true lifetime cost.
- [Why Your Next Raise Won't Set You Free](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-next-raise-won-t-set-you-free/): A higher salary rarely creates freedom because lifestyle creep spends every new dollar. Learn how replacing fear and desire with real assets builds true passive income.
- [Why You Waste Tax Refunds (And How to Stop)](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-you-waste-tax-refunds-and-how-to-stop/): Exposing the House Money Effect and mental accounting bias. Learn why treating tax refunds differently than paychecks leads to wasted cash, and how single-bucket routing fixes it.
- [The Brutal Math of Starting at 20 vs 30](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-brutal-math-of-starting-at-20-vs-30/): Comparing the math of investing $200 a month starting at age 20 versus waiting until 30, assuming an 8% return until age 65.
- [The Silent Inflation Cash Devaluation](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-silent-inflation-cash-devaluation/): Computing the exact purchasing power loss of keeping cash in a 0.01% savings account over 15 years at a historical 3% inflation rate.

This 15-minute sinking fund system splits irregular expenses into payday automated transfers so you never pay debt interest on predictable life expenses.
- [Why 'Free' Makes You Spend $50 Extra](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-free-makes-you-spend-50-extra/): Explaining the Zero-Price Effect and why free shipping prompts consumers to overspend on items they do not need.
